dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: Why do I research ancient ruins? Out of curiosity, naturally! Surely you find the tantalizing traces of history inside irresistible too?

dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: Reading The Mondstadt Tower was what first got me interested in history.

dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: Everyone describes it as a historical romance, but... Personally, I didn't see what was so romantic about it when I read it.

dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: If you've never read it, you should take this copy. Seriously, it's a good read.
